chunks: God had promised you many spoils that you would capture; so He gave this soon enough to you, and stayed the hands of men from you that it may serve as a sign for believers, and guide you on the straight path;
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah as a divine victory in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is viewed as a divine pivot from the diplomatic 'victory' of Hudaybiyyah to the eventual conquest of Mecca, illustrating how God accelerated the fulfillment of His promise to secure the believers' hearts. It emphasizes that the true 'spoils' were not merely material but the spiritual consolidation of the community, serving as a definitive sign (ayah) for the faithful to recognize divine guidance amidst political ambiguity.
